grammar: n. 场所；地点；遗址；网站。可数，复数 sites；语境可指施工地、考古遗址或互联网网站。
collocations: an archaeological site; a building site; visit a website
commonMistake: site 可指地点或遗址，也可指网站；不要与 sight（视力、景象）混淆拼写。

example.english: The team discovered pottery at the archaeological site.
example.chinese: 考察队在考古遗址发现了陶器。

application.prompt: The archaeologists set up camp at the excavation ___ where they found the old walls. A. site B. sight
application.solution: A。解析：挖掘地点的固定表达是 excavation site（挖掘现场/遗址）；sight 指景象或视力。

grammar: n. （有历史价值的）人工制品。可数，复数 artefacts；英式拼写 artefact，美式常拼 artifact。
collocations: an ancient artefact; a museum artefact; discover artefacts
commonMistake: artefact 与 artifact 都是正确拼写，前者偏英式、后者偏美式；此词表采用 artefact，不要把 artifact 判为拼写错误。

example.english: The museum displayed an artefact made by early farmers.
example.chinese: 博物馆展出了一件早期农民制作的人工制品。

application.prompt: The museum displayed a stone ___ made by people thousands of years ago. A. fossil B. artefact
application.solution: B。解析：古人制作并遗留下来的物品是 artefact（人工制品）；fossil 是化石。

examTags: 熟词多义·动物角与喇叭
grammar: n. （牛、羊等的）角；号角；喇叭。可数，复数 horns；动物角常成对出现。
collocations: a pair of horns; a bull's horn; sound the horn
commonMistake: horn 可指动物的角，也可指车辆喇叭；谈牛羊头上的角时通常用复数 horns。

example.english: The young goat's horns had begun to grow.
example.chinese: 这只小山羊的角开始长出来了。

application.prompt: The goat has two curved ___ on its head. A. horns B. feathers
application.solution: A。解析：山羊头上长出的弯曲部分是 horns（角）；feathers 是羽毛。

examTags: 词汇·国籍形容词与名词
grammar: adj. 埃及的；n. 埃及人。作形容词修饰名词，首字母大写；复数名词 Egyptians。
collocations: Egyptian history; an Egyptian museum; ancient Egyptians
commonMistake: Egypt 是国名，Egyptian 才是“埃及的/埃及人”；国籍词首字母大写。

example.english: The students learned about Egyptian history in the museum.
example.chinese: 学生们在博物馆了解了埃及历史。

application.prompt: The collection includes pottery from ___ tombs near Cairo. A. Egypt B. Egyptian
application.solution: B。解析：名词 tombs 前需要形容词 Egyptian 修饰；Egypt 是国名，不能直接作此处的形容词。

grammar: n. 女皇；皇后。可数，复数 empresses；男性对应词为 emperor。
collocations: an empress of China; a powerful empress; the empress's tomb
commonMistake: empress 指女皇或皇后，emperor 指男皇帝；复数需在 -ss 后加 -es，写作 empresses。

example.english: The guide told us how the empress ruled the kingdom.
example.chinese: 导游给我们讲了这位女皇如何统治王国。

application.prompt: The ruler was a woman who held the highest imperial position. She was an ___. A. emperor B. empress
application.solution: B。解析：女性皇帝称为 empress（女皇）；emperor 通常指男性皇帝。

grammar: n. 女王；王后；蜂王。可数，复数 queens；在棋类中也指“后”。
collocations: the queen of a country; a queen bee; the queen's palace
commonMistake: queen 可指女王或国王的妻子，需结合语境辨义；男性对应词常为 king。

example.english: The queen welcomed visitors to the royal palace.
example.chinese: 女王在王宫欢迎来访者。

application.prompt: In the story, the king's wife wore a crown and was called the ___. A. queen B. king
application.solution: A。解析：国王的妻子称为 queen（王后）；king 是男性国王。

examTags: 熟词多义·木乃伊与儿语
grammar: n. 木乃伊；（儿语）妈妈。可数，复数 mummies；历史和博物馆语境中常指经过处理保存的遗体。
collocations: an Egyptian mummy; a mummy in a tomb; unwrap a mummy
commonMistake: mummy 可表示木乃伊，也可作儿童对妈妈的称呼；此处历史语境取“木乃伊”，不要与 mummy 的亲昵称呼混淆。

example.english: The mummy was kept in a glass case at the museum.
example.chinese: 这具木乃伊保存在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。

application.prompt: The preserved body of the ancient ruler was displayed as an Egyptian ___. A. mummy B. statue
application.solution: A。解析：经过保存处理的古代遗体是 mummy（木乃伊）；statue 是雕像。

grammar: n. 考古学家。可数，复数 archaeologists；由 archaeology（考古学）加 -ist 构成。
collocations: a team of archaeologists; an archaeologist at work; become an archaeologist
commonMistake: archaeologist 拼写中有 ae；archeologist 是美式简化变体，也正确，教材词表使用 archaeologist。

example.english: An archaeologist examined the tools found near the tomb.
example.chinese: 一位考古学家检查了在墓穴附近发现的工具。

application.prompt: The person studying the buried tools and buildings works as an ___. A. architect B. archaeologist
application.solution: B。解析：研究出土器物和古代遗址的人是 archaeologist（考古学家）；architect 是建筑师。

grammar: adj. 富裕的；有财的。可作定语或表语；比较级 wealthier，最高级 wealthiest；名词为 wealth。
collocations: a wealthy family; become wealthy; a wealthy country
commonMistake: wealthy 是形容词，修饰名词；wealth 是名词，表示财富。比较级去 y 加 -ier：wealthier。

example.english: The wealthy merchant paid for the village school.
example.chinese: 这位富有的商人为村里的学校出资。

application.prompt: The family owned several businesses and had plenty of money. They were ___. A. wealth B. wealthy
application.solution: B。解析：be 动词后需要形容词作表语，wealthy 表示“富裕的”；wealth 是名词。

grammar: n. 衣物；服装，通常不可数，谓语用单数；一件衣物可说 an item/article of clothing。
collocations: traditional clothing; protective clothing; an item of clothing
commonMistake: clothing 通常不可数，不说 clothings；cloth 表示布料，clothes 表示衣服且通常用复数。

example.english: The museum displayed traditional clothing from several regions.
example.chinese: 博物馆展出了来自几个地区的传统服装。

application.prompt: The museum's collection of traditional ___ includes robes and sandals. A. clothings B. clothing
application.solution: B。解析：clothing 是不可数集合名词，不能加复数 -s；此处指各类传统服装。

examTags: 语法·不可数名词与材质
grammar: n. 棉；棉花；棉织物。作原料时通常不可数；作定语修饰名词时说 cotton clothes/shirt。
collocations: cotton fabric; a cotton shirt; grow cotton
commonMistake: cotton 表示棉这种材料时不可数；说一件棉衬衫用 a cotton shirt，而不是 a cotton。

example.english: This soft shirt is made from locally grown cotton.
example.chinese: 这件柔软的衬衫由当地种植的棉花制成。

application.prompt: The shirt feels soft because it is made of ___. A. cotton B. woollen
application.solution: A。解析：句中需要表示棉这种材料的名词 cotton；woollen 是形容词“羊毛制的”。

grammar: n. 克（重量单位）。可数；单数 gram，复数 grams；英式拼法 gramme 也存在。
collocations: five grams of sugar; a 200-gram package; weigh in grams
commonMistake: 数字大于一时通常用 grams；作复合形容词时单位常用单数，如 a 200-gram bag。

example.english: The recipe needs 150 grams of flour.
example.chinese: 这个食谱需要150克面粉。

application.prompt: The recipe says to add 250 ___ of flour. A. gram B. grams
application.solution: B。解析：250 是复数数量，计量单位用 grams；作前置复合定语时才常用单数形式。

grammar: n. 磅（重量单位）；英镑等货币单位。可数，复数 pounds；意义由数字、货物或价格语境判断。
collocations: a pound of apples; weigh ten pounds; five pounds sterling
commonMistake: pound 可表示重量“磅”或货币“英镑”；有重量动词 weigh、食物等语境时取重量义。

example.english: The box weighs about five pounds.
example.chinese: 这个箱子大约重五磅。

application.prompt: The fruit seller put two ___ of apples on the scale. A. pounds B. dollars
application.solution: A。解析：苹果放在秤上称量，句中需要重量单位 pounds（磅），不是货币 dollars。

grammar: n. 火柴盒。可数，复数 matchboxes；由 match + box 构成，box 以 x 结尾加 -es。
collocations: a box of matches; an empty matchbox; matchboxes on a shelf
commonMistake: matchbox 的复数是 matchboxes，词尾 x 加 -es；matchbox 是盒子，matches 才是盒中的火柴。

example.english: He found an old matchbox in the drawer.
example.chinese: 他在抽屉里发现了一个旧火柴盒。

application.prompt: There are three empty ___ in the kitchen drawer. A. matchboxs B. matchboxes
application.solution: B。解析：matchbox 以 x 结尾，变复数加 -es，写作 matchboxes。

grammar: n. 灰烬；灰；废墟。作燃烧后的灰烬时通常不可数；ash tree 则指白蜡树。
collocations: wood ash; a pile of ash; ash from a fire
commonMistake: ash 表示灰烬时通常不可数；一堆灰可说 a pile of ash，不要直接说 an ash。

example.english: After the fire went out, only a little ash remained.
example.chinese: 火熄灭后，只剩下一点灰烬。

application.prompt: After the paper burned completely, a little ___ was left in the tray. A. ash B. asheses
application.solution: A。解析：此处 ash 表示燃烧后的灰烬，通常作不可数名词；asheses 不是正确形式。

grammar: adj. 不大可能发生的。由 un- + likely 构成；常用 be unlikely to do 或 It is unlikely that...。
collocations: be unlikely to happen; an unlikely result; it is unlikely that...
commonMistake: unlikely 是形容词，常用 be unlikely to do；不能把 unlikely 当副词修饰动词。

example.english: It is unlikely to snow here in the middle of summer.
example.chinese: 盛夏时这里不太可能下雪。

application.prompt: The sky is clear and the forecast says 35°C, so it is ___ to snow today. A. likely B. unlikely
application.solution: B。解析：晴朗且气温很高时今天不大可能下雪，用 unlikely。

grammar: n. 玉；翡翠。表示材料时通常不可数；具体一件玉器可说 a piece of jade 或 a jade ornament。
collocations: a jade bracelet; a piece of jade; carve jade
commonMistake: jade 作材料名词通常不可数；说玉手镯用 a jade bracelet，不说 a jade 表示一件玉石制品。

example.english: The small jade pendant had been passed down for generations.
example.chinese: 这枚小玉坠已经代代相传。

application.prompt: The bracelet is made from a polished green stone called ___. A. jade B. glassy
application.solution: A。解析：made from 后接表示材料的名词 jade（玉）；glassy 是形容词，不能作此处宾语。

grammar: n. 财富；财产，通常不可数；wealthy 是形容词“富裕的”。可说 a great deal of wealth。
collocations: great wealth; a source of wealth; distribute wealth
commonMistake: wealth 是名词，wealthy 是形容词；通常不说 many wealths，数量可用 much/a great deal of。

example.english: The tomb contained objects that showed the ruler's great wealth.
example.chinese: 墓中有一些物品，显示出这位统治者曾拥有巨额财富。

application.prompt: The treasures in the tomb revealed the ruler's great ___. A. wealthy B. wealth
application.solution: B。解析：所有格 ruler's 后需要名词作 great 的中心词，wealth 表示“财富”；wealthy 是形容词。

grammar: n. 贸易；买卖；v. 交易；交换。常用 trade with sb、trade in goods；过去式 traded。
collocations: international trade; trade with other countries; trade goods for food
commonMistake: trade in + 商品表示经营或交易某类商品；trade sth for sth 表示用某物交换另一物。

example.english: The two towns traded pottery and cloth for grain.
example.chinese: 这两个城镇用陶器和布匹交换粮食。

application.prompt: In the past, the coastal town used to ___ salt for pottery from the inland village. A. trade B. travel
application.solution: A。解析：用盐换陶器的行为是 trade A for B（用 A 交换 B）；travel 是旅行。

grammar: v. 修理；修补；n. 修理。可说 repair a wall、repair a machine；名词常用 make repairs 或 under repair。
collocations: repair a roof; repair the damage; under repair
commonMistake: repair 可直接接需要修理的物品；表示修理费用也可用 the cost of repairs，别把 repair 写成名词复数 repairs 的动词形式。

example.english: Workers repaired the stone gate after the storm.
example.chinese: 暴风雨后，工人修好了石门。

application.prompt: The old bridge was damaged, so engineers came to ___ it. A. repeat B. repair
application.solution: B。解析：工程师来修好受损的桥，用 repair（修理）；repeat 是“重复”。

grammar: phr. 使……鲜活起来；赋予生命。bring—brought—brought；宾语置于 bring 和 to life 之间。
collocations: bring a story to life; bring history to life; bring the past to life
commonMistake: 宾语放在 bring 与 to life 之间，如 bring the past to life；不要把 to life 拆到宾语前。

example.english: The guide's stories brought the ancient city to life.
example.chinese: 导游的讲述让这座古城变得鲜活起来。

application.prompt: The guide used stories and pictures to ___ the ancient city ___ for the children. A. bring / to life B. bring to life / it
application.solution: A。解析：bring something to life 表示“使某物鲜活起来”，宾语 the ancient city 放在 bring 与 to life 之间。

sources.label: Cambridge Dictionary: bring something to life

grammar: adj. 考古学的。由 archaeology（考古学）派生，修饰 site、discovery、evidence 等名词。
collocations: archaeological research; an archaeological discovery; an archaeological site
commonMistake: archaeological 是形容词，名词 archaeology 指考古学；注意拼写中的 ae。

example.english: The team made an important archaeological discovery near the river.
example.chinese: 考察队在河边有了一项重要的考古发现。

application.prompt: The team used old maps and careful digging to make an ___ discovery. A. archaeologist B. archaeological
application.solution: B。解析：名词 discovery 前需要形容词 archaeological（考古学的）；archaeologist 是考古学家。

grammar: phr. 数百万（的）；大量（的）。不具体指数量时用 millions of + 复数名词；具体数词后用 three million people，不加 -s 或 of。
collocations: millions of years; millions of people; cost millions of dollars
commonMistake: 泛指“大量”用 millions of + 复数名词；具体数目如 five million 后直接接名词，不加 -s，也通常不加 of。

example.english: Millions of visitors come to the historic site each year.
example.chinese: 每年有数百万游客来到这处历史遗址。

application.prompt: No exact number was given, but ___ people visit the ancient city every year. A. millions of B. three millions
application.solution: A。解析：泛指数百万游客用 millions of people；具体数词后 million 不加 -s。

grammar: n. 门；大门；入口。可数，复数 gates；常用 the gate to/of a place。
collocations: the main gate; a garden gate; enter through the gate
commonMistake: gate 通常指院落、围墙或场地出入口；room 的门常用 door。

example.english: The visitors waited outside the main gate until it opened.
example.chinese: 游客们在正门外等到它开放。

application.prompt: The wall surrounded the palace, and visitors entered through its huge stone ___. A. roof B. gate
application.solution: B。解析：穿过围墙进入宫殿的入口是 gate（大门）；roof 是屋顶。

grammar: adj. 知道的；意识到的。常作表语，用 be/become aware that... 或 be aware of + 名词。
collocations: be aware of a problem; become aware that...; fully aware
commonMistake: aware 通常不直接放在名词前作定语；常用 be aware of/that 作表语，aware 不可直接接名词。

example.english: The visitors were aware that the floor was uneven.
example.chinese: 游客们知道地面并不平整。

application.prompt: Before entering the tomb, the visitors were ___ that the floor could be slippery. A. aware B. notice
application.solution: A。解析：be aware that... 表示“知道/意识到……”，be 后需接形容词 aware；notice 是动词。

grammar: phr. 知道；意识到。结构为 be/become aware of + 名词或代词；若后接完整句子，通常用 aware that...。
collocations: be aware of the danger; make someone aware of a fact; become aware of a sound
commonMistake: aware of 后接名词或代词；接完整主谓句时用 aware that...，不要说 aware of that the gate is closed。

example.english: The guide made us aware of the rules before the tour began.
example.chinese: 参观开始前，导游让我们了解了这些规则。

application.prompt: After seeing the warning sign, the visitors became aware ___ the danger. A. at B. of
application.solution: B。解析：become aware of + 名词表示“意识到危险”；本句 danger 是名词，搭配用 of。

examTags: 词汇·副词、形容词与名词
grammar: adv. 在地下；adj. 地下的；n. 地铁（英式用法）。可作定语，如 an underground room；也可作地点副词。
collocations: an underground room; travel underground; take the underground
commonMistake: underground 作副词时前面不加 to，如 go underground；作英国地铁名词时常说 the Underground。

example.english: The ancient storage room was built underground to stay cool.
example.chinese: 这间古代储藏室建在地下以保持凉爽。

application.prompt: To protect the food from heat, the villagers stored it in a room ___. A. underground B. upstairs
application.solution: A。解析：为避暑而建在地面以下的房间位于 underground（地下）。

grammar: n. 深坑；矿井；（水果的）核。可数，复数 pits；含义根据 dig、fruit 等语境判断。
collocations: dig a pit; a deep pit; a peach pit
commonMistake: pit 可指地上的坑，也可指某些水果的硬核；句中出现挖掘、地面或深度时通常取“坑”义。

example.english: The workers dug a deep pit beside the old wall.
example.chinese: 工人在旧墙旁挖了一个深坑。

application.prompt: The workers dug a deep ___ to reach the buried stones below the ground. A. gate B. pit
application.solution: B。解析：向下挖掘以接近地下石块形成的是 pit（深坑）。

grammar: adj. 举世闻名的；世界著名的。常作定语或表语；由 world + famous 构成，通常加连字符。
collocations: a world-famous site; become world-famous; a world-famous collection
commonMistake: world-famous 是连字符连接的复合形容词；名词前作定语时不要拆成 world famous 两词。

example.english: The world-famous pyramid attracts visitors from many countries.
example.chinese: 这座举世闻名的金字塔吸引着来自许多国家的游客。

application.prompt: The ancient monument is known by people around the globe; it is ___. A. world-famous B. famous-world
application.solution: A。解析：表示“举世闻名的”固定写作 world-famous，连字符连接且顺序不能颠倒。

grammar: v. 挖（土）；掘（地）。dig—dug—dug；常用 dig a hole、dig for something。
collocations: dig a hole; dig for ancient objects; dig up the ground
commonMistake: dig 的过去式和过去分词都是 dug，不是 digged；表示挖掘寻找某物可用 dig for。

example.english: The archaeologists dug carefully around the stone box.
example.chinese: 考古学家在石箱周围小心地挖掘。

application.prompt: Yesterday the team ___ a narrow trench beside the wall. A. digged B. dug
application.solution: B。解析：dig 的过去式是 dug；句中 Yesterday 表明动作发生在过去。

examTags: 熟词多义·遗迹与剩余物
grammar: n. 遗迹；遗骸；剩余部分，常用复数形式 remains；the remains of... 指某物留下的残余。
collocations: the remains of a temple; human remains; ancient remains
commonMistake: remains 作“遗迹/遗骸”时通常用复数形式，前面可接 the；不要因词尾 -s 误认为它一定是动词。

example.english: The remains of the old bridge can still be seen near the river.
example.chinese: 河边仍能看到这座旧桥的遗迹。

application.prompt: The walls that survived the earthquake are the ___ of the ancient palace. A. remains B. remained
application.solution: A。解析：此处需要名词表示宫殿留下的遗迹，the remains of... 是固定用法；remained 是动词过去式。

grammar: n. 时代；年代。可数，复数 eras；常用 the ... era 表示某一历史时期。
collocations: an ancient era; the modern era; a new era begins
commonMistake: era 指一段较长的历史时期，前有元音音素时用 an era；不要与一年的日期 year 混淆。

example.english: The tools reveal how people lived in that era.
example.chinese: 这些工具揭示了那个时代人们的生活方式。

application.prompt: The invention changed daily life and marked the beginning of a new ___. A. error B. era
application.solution: B。解析：改变社会生活并开启的新“时代”是 era；error 表示错误。

grammar: adv. 非常；高度地。常修饰形容词、过去分词或表示评价的动词，如 highly skilled、highly valued。
collocations: highly skilled; highly respected; highly likely
commonMistake: highly 常用于评价程度较高或受重视的语境；物理高度通常用 high，不用 highly。

example.english: The highly skilled workers repaired the stone carving.
example.chinese: 这些技艺高超的工人修复了石雕。

application.prompt: The craft requires great ability, so only ___ trained workers can do it well. A. highly B. high
application.solution: A。解析：修饰过去分词 trained、表示“训练有素的/高度训练的”用 highly；high 通常表示物理高度。

grammar: adj. 有技能的；熟练的。由 skill + -ed 构成；常修饰人或工人，也可用 highly skilled 加强程度。
collocations: a skilled worker; highly skilled craftspeople; a skilled job
commonMistake: skilled 是形容词，skill 是名词；可说 a skilled carver 或 have the skill to do sth。

example.english: A skilled craftsperson can shape the metal without damaging it.
example.chinese: 熟练的工匠能在不损坏金属的情况下将它塑形。

application.prompt: The ___ carver produced fine details on the stone statue. A. skill B. skilled
application.solution: B。解析：名词 carver 前需要形容词 skilled 修饰；skill 是名词，不能直接作此处的定语。

grammar: phr. 善于；精通。结构为 be skilled in + 名词或动名词，常说明某人擅长的领域或活动。
collocations: be skilled in archaeology; skilled in carving; highly skilled in a craft
commonMistake: skilled in 后接名词或动名词；谈领域可说 skilled in metalwork，不能说 skilled on metalwork。

example.english: The artisan was skilled in carving delicate patterns in jade.
example.chinese: 这位工匠擅长在玉上雕刻精致的纹样。

application.prompt: The researcher is highly skilled ___ identifying ancient tools. A. on B. in
application.solution: B。解析：表示擅长某领域或活动用 be skilled in；后接动名词 identifying。

examTags: 语法·不可数名词与材质
grammar: n. 金属。材料义通常不可数；说不同种类可用 metals；metal 也可作定语修饰工具、门等。
collocations: a piece of metal; metal tools; made of metal
commonMistake: metal 表示金属材料时通常不可数；说一块金属用 a piece of metal，而不是 a metal（除非指一种金属）。

example.english: The handle was made of metal and felt cold to the touch.
example.chinese: 这个把手是金属制的，摸起来很凉。

application.prompt: The old key was made from a hard, shiny ___. A. metal B. wooden
application.solution: A。解析：a hard, shiny 后需要名词作 made from 的宾语，metal 表示金属；wooden 是形容词。

grammar: v. 雕刻；刻出。carve—carved—carved；常用 carve sth from/out of wood、carve a pattern into stone。
collocations: carve a statue; carve a pattern into stone; carve wood
commonMistake: carve 指用工具切削材料做出形状；过去式和过去分词均加 -d，写作 carved。

example.english: The artist carved a small bird from a piece of wood.
example.chinese: 艺术家用一块木头雕出了一只小鸟。

application.prompt: The artist used a knife to ___ a bird from a block of wood. A. paint B. carve
application.solution: B。解析：用刀从木块上刻出鸟的形状是 carve；paint 表示绘画或涂色。

examTags: 词汇·可数与不可数名词
grammar: n. 样式；风格；款式。可数，复数 styles；也可表示个人的表达方式或生活方式。
collocations: a traditional style; in the style of; a unique style
commonMistake: style 指作品或事物呈现的风格；in the style of + 人/时期表示“采用……的风格”，不可漏掉 the。

example.english: The museum displays pottery in the style of the ancient Mayans.
example.chinese: 博物馆展出了具有古代玛雅人风格的陶器。

application.prompt: The building is designed ___ the ancient palace. A. in the style of B. by a style of
application.solution: A。解析：表示“采用古代宫殿的风格”用 in the style of；by a style of 不能表达这一句意。

grammar: adj. 独特的；罕见的；独一无二的。常作表语或定语；通常不用于比较级，常说 a unique feature。
collocations: a unique design; unique to this region; a unique opportunity
commonMistake: unique 本身含“独一无二”之意，通常不说 more unique；发音以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，前用 a unique...。

example.english: Each hand-carved figure has a unique expression.
example.chinese: 每个手工雕刻的人像都有独特的表情。

application.prompt: No other object in the collection is quite like it; the design is ___. A. unique B. usual
application.solution: A。解析：与收藏中其他物品都不同，说明设计是 unique（独特的）；usual 是“通常的”。

grammar: n. 证据；证明，通常不可数；一条证据可说 a piece of evidence；动词为 prove。
collocations: strong evidence; a piece of evidence; evidence of a past civilization
commonMistake: evidence 通常不可数，不说 an evidence 或 evidences；数一条证据时用 a piece of evidence。

example.english: The tools provided evidence of a settlement near the river.
example.chinese: 这些工具为河边曾有聚居点提供了证据。

application.prompt: The broken pottery is ___ that people lived here long ago. A. an evidence B. evidence
application.solution: B。解析：evidence 通常不可数，作表语时直接用 evidence，不能加不定冠词 an。

grammar: n. 目的；目标；v. 力求达到；瞄准。常用 aim to do、aim at doing；名词常用 the aim of。
collocations: aim to preserve the site; the main aim; aim at a target
commonMistake: aim to 后接动词原形；aim at 后接名词或动名词。不要把 aim at do sth 与 aim to do sth 混用。

example.english: The project aims to protect the ancient walls from further damage.
example.chinese: 这个项目旨在保护古城墙免受进一步损坏。

application.prompt: The research team hopes to preserve the site. Its main aim is ___ the old walls. A. protect B. to protect
application.solution: B。解析：aim 作“目标”时常用 the aim is to do；后接不定式 to protect。

grammar: n. 元（美国、加拿大等国的货币单位）。可数，复数 dollars；数额前可用 $ 符号，符号后不再写 dollar。
collocations: ten dollars; a dollar coin; pay in US dollars
commonMistake: 一个单位用 a dollar，多个用 dollars；$25 已含货币符号，通常不再写 25 dollars 并重复表达。

example.english: The small guidebook costs five dollars at the museum shop.
example.chinese: 这本小指南在博物馆商店售价五美元。

application.prompt: The ticket costs $12, which is twelve ___. A. dollar B. dollars
application.solution: B。解析：数词 twelve 后的可数货币单位用复数 dollars。

grammar: n. 分；分币。可数，复数 cents；在使用美元的货币体系中 100 cents = 1 dollar。
collocations: fifty cents; a ten-cent coin; cost 99 cents
commonMistake: 一个单位用 a cent，多个用 cents；作前置复合定语时常用单数，如 a ten-cent coin。

example.english: The postcard costs eighty cents, less than one dollar.
example.chinese: 这张明信片售价八十分，不到一美元。

application.prompt: One dollar is equal to one hundred ___. A. cents B. cent
application.solution: A。解析：100 是复数数量，因此用 cents；一个单位才用 cent。

grammar: n. 雕塑；雕像。可数，复数 statues；常指塑造出人物或动物形象的立体作品。
collocations: a stone statue; a statue of a king; a bronze statue
commonMistake: statue 是可数名词，单数前通常要有冠词；它指立体雕像，statute（法规）拼写相近但含义不同。

example.english: A bronze statue of the queen stands in the town square.
example.chinese: 镇广场上立着一尊女王的青铜雕像。

application.prompt: The sculptor created a life-size figure of the ruler from stone. The finished work is a ___. A. statue B. statute
application.solution: A。解析：由石头塑成的立体人物作品是 statue（雕像）；statute 是法规。

examTags: 词汇·民族与语言形容词
grammar: adj. 玛雅人的；玛雅语的；n. 玛雅人；玛雅语。作民族、语言形容词或名词时首字母大写。
collocations: Mayan culture; Mayan ruins; the Mayan language
commonMistake: Mayan 是首字母大写的民族或语言名称；作普通形容词时也保留大写，不要写成 mayan。

example.english: The guide explained how Mayan builders designed the stone temples.
example.chinese: 导游讲解了玛雅建造者如何设计石庙。

application.prompt: The temples were built by an ancient Central American people, so they are described as ___ temples. A. Roman B. Mayan
application.solution: B。解析：题干指向玛雅文明，修饰 temples 用 Mayan（玛雅人的）；Roman 指古罗马的。

grammar: n. 影子；阴影。可数，复数 shadows；常由光被人或物遮挡形成，也可作动词表示跟踪。
collocations: cast a shadow; in the shadow of a tree; a long shadow
commonMistake: shadow 常指光线被遮挡形成的影子；shade 多指阴凉处或遮蔽，不要把两词在所有语境中互换。

example.english: At sunset, the statue cast a long shadow across the ground.
example.chinese: 日落时，雕像在地面上投下了长长的影子。

application.prompt: With the sun behind it, the statue cast a long ___ across the path. A. shadow B. sunshine
application.solution: A。解析：雕像挡住阳光后投在地上的黑色轮廓是 shadow（影子）；sunshine 是阳光。

grammar: v. 爬行；爬。crawl—crawled—crawled；常用 crawl on one's hands and knees、crawl under something。
collocations: crawl on the ground; crawl under a table; a baby crawls
commonMistake: crawl 的过去式直接加 -ed：crawled；不要把 y 改成 i，因为 y 前是元音字母 a。

example.english: The baby crawled across the soft carpet toward his mother.
example.chinese: 婴儿朝妈妈爬过柔软的地毯。

application.prompt: The baby moved on hands and knees across the floor; she ___ toward the toy. A. crawled B. crawlied
application.solution: A。解析：crawl 的过去式是 crawled；y 前是元音字母 a，因此直接加 -ed。

grammar: adv. 有趣地；有意思的是。由 interesting + -ly 构成；可置于句首修饰整句，后接逗号。
collocations: Interestingly, ...; behave interestingly; an interestingly different result
commonMistake: interestingly 是副词，常用 Interestingly, ... 引出值得注意的信息；interesting 是形容词，不能直接替代句首副词。

example.english: Interestingly, the oldest tools were found far from the river.
example.chinese: 有意思的是，最古老的工具是在远离河流的地方发现的。

application.prompt: ___, the smallest statue was also the most carefully decorated. A. Interesting B. Interestingly
application.solution: B。解析：句首修饰整句话、引出“有意思的是”时用副词 Interestingly，并通常加逗号。

grammar: n. CT 扫描；计算机断层扫描。可数，复数 CT scans；CT 是 computerized tomography 的缩写，字母通常大写。
collocations: have a CT scan; a CT scan of the head; CT scan results
commonMistake: CT scan 是可数名词，做一次检查说 have a CT scan；缩写 CT 两个字母都大写。

example.english: The doctor ordered a CT scan to examine the injury.
example.chinese: 医生安排了一次 CT 扫描来检查伤情。

application.prompt: The doctor used a machine to create detailed images of the inside of the patient's body. She had a ___. A. CT scan B. blood type
application.solution: A。解析：用计算机断层成像检查身体内部的是 CT scan；blood type 是血型。

grammar: n. DNA 检测。可数，复数 DNA tests；常说 have/take a DNA test，DNA 字母通常大写。
collocations: take a DNA test; DNA test results; a DNA test for identification
commonMistake: DNA test 是可数名词，单数前用 a；DNA 要大写，test 可按数量变化为 tests。

example.english: The DNA test helped scientists identify the remains.
example.chinese: DNA 检测帮助科学家确认了遗骸的身份。

application.prompt: To learn whether the two people were related, the scientists carried out a ___. A. DNA test B. DNA tested
application.solution: A。解析：carry out a 后接名词短语 DNA test，表示进行一次 DNA 检测；tested 是动词过去式/过去分词。
